name: git-guardrails
description: Refuses risky git, gh and docker commands before they run: direct pushes to protected branches, PRs based on feature branches, commit subjects over 72 characters or with '!', AI attribution, a compose stack started without its env variable, and two sessions switching branches in one checkout.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branches nobody pushes to directly.

composeEnv.title: Compose env check
composeEnv.description: dir:VARIABLE. `docker compose up` under a path containing dir is refused unless VARIABLE appears in the command (for a variable a non-interactive shell would miss). Empty turns the rule off.
